Homemade green tea ice cream
By: Easy cook - Lak...
Published: Sunday, July 8, 2012 - 9:06am

Ingredients




2 tbs green tea leaves
2 tbs boiling water
1 tbs sugar
1 ¼ cups milk
2 egg yolks
¼ cup caster sugar
1 ¼ cups heavy cream
1 tbs vanilla extract

Preparation

1 Soak the dry green tea and in boiling water with the tablespoon of sugar for 10-12 minutes. 2 Into a saucepan put the milk and gently bring to the boil then pour over the tea. Leave to stand for 5 minutes. 3 Beat the egg yolks with the ¼ cup caster sugar in a separate bowl for 3 minutes. 4 Strain the milk mixture into it,  whisking constantly. 5 Transfer to a saucepan and gently heat, stirring all the time, until the mixture is thick. Immediately remove from the heat and cool in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours. 6 Whip the cream and fold into the cooled tea mixture. 7 Mix in the vanilla extract 8 Pour the mixture into an ice cream machine and churn until frozen. Transfer to plastic container and place in the freezer for an hour before serving. 9 Serving: take it out for 5-10 minutes before serving, or longer, so it comes to the right scooping temperature. 10 Easy suggestion: ice cream is best served in chilled glass or porcelain bowls. Scoop it with a hot, but dry, ice-cream spoon (soak it in boiling water, then wipe dry).

About

Cool and delicious treat for the green tea lovers.
